name: Online Store
description: Tienda completa: catálogo con variantes y galerías, carrito, checkout con validación server-side, cupones, zonas de envío + recogida, impuestos simples, pedidos por cuenta, correos transaccionales, reembolsos (incluye Stripe), informes con CSV y webhooks de Stripe. Pago manual siempre disponible; Stripe opcional por sitio.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read products, variants, galleries, shipping zones, orders and coupons; read the Stripe secret key from the plugin's own settings table (options are a shared namespace, so the key lives in a wjp_ table).

Create/update products, variants, galleries, shipping zones, orders and coupons; decrement per-variant stock and consume coupon uses atomically; record refunds; store the write-only Stripe key in the plugin's own settings table.
Read the store configuration (currency, shipping, pickup, taxes, manual payment instructions, notification email).
Save the store configuration from the admin page.
Public catalog/checkout/order-lookup/webhook endpoints for the store blocks, an authenticated order-history endpoint for logged-in customers, and admin CRUD/report endpoints.
Add the 'Tienda Online' entry to the admin sidebar.

Send transactional order emails to customers (received / payment receipt / shipped / cancelled / refunded) and new-order notifications to the store email (best effort — orders are created even if mail fails).

Call the Stripe API (api.stripe.com) to create and verify Checkout Sessions, verify webhook events server-side (the webhook body is never trusted directly) and issue refunds when a Stripe key is configured.
